messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1777777777 - router:fallback_policy -> high-error-rate, dedicated-pool allocations dropped 95%
ops-bot: summary: 5xx spike across eu-west routes, large fraction routed to fallback variants, pool 'dedicated-eu-gen2' reporting 0 available slots while cloud metrics show instances still running

maria_oncall: picking this up — looking at router dashboards now. Is this impacting any hosted customers (SLA)?

tom_router: seeing router-side metric flip: variant_score for 'redwood/quant-v2' jumped to preferred in policy selector at 17:49:10 but health-checks for that variant show TLS handshake failures (502)

sasha_sre: confirmed 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 18% over last 6m on /v1/generate for eu region. Traces show requests routed to fallback region us-central then dropped inside dedicated pool proxy (blackholed).

maria_oncall: timeline pls. first_message_ts -> 17:49:37 UTC?

ops-bot: event timeline appended: autoscaler:heartbeat_miss for pool dedicated-eu-gen2 at 17:48:55, router:policy_eval change at 17:49:10, pool_health:agent-reported-0-slots at 17:49:45

lee_infra: autoscaler logs: saw heartbeat metric 'pool_alive' tag go from t:true -> t:false after a config deploy that renamed tag from pool_alive to pool.up. New agent version didn't map old tag -> autoscaler considered pool unhealthy and initiated scale-down (grace period skipped due to noise filter).

amanda_eng: oh no — config rename shipped in 17.48 deploy, missed in rollout checklist. That explains heartbeat misread.

maria_oncall: immediate mitigation options: 1) pause fallback policy at router (prevent model variant switch) 2) force scale up pool and mark healthy 3) route around dedicated pool (send to hosted) — which is fastest?

tom_router: pausing fallback policy is fastest (single flip) — will stop routing to quant-v2. But blackholed connections still in proxy; we should also mark pool drained = false to accept connections.

sasha_sre: agree — do both. Pausing fallback w/rollback key then manual scale up. Also adding temporary circuit breaker to route to hosted API for requests hitting 5xx threshold.

maria_oncall: tom, do a soft flip and annotate with rollback window. lee, can you force healthy on pool and push manual scale to +4 nodes?

amanda_eng: deploying config to router now — pausing policy 'variant_fallback_v3' in eu region. Command: 
```
# toggle fallback policy
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/policies/variant_fallback_v3/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

ops-bot: action recorded by amanda_eng at 17:51:02

tom_router: policy paused. Confirmed router stopped selecting quant-v2 for new requests. Old inflight still show failures though.

lee_infra: forcing pool healthy: 
```
# mark pool healthy and request scale
infractl pools mark-healthy --pool dedicated-eu-gen2 --by ops
infractl pools scale --pool dedicated-eu-gen2 --replicas +4 --reason "heartbeat tag rename revert"
```

ops-bot: scale job queued, new nodes provisioning (GCE) 17:51:40

jordan_prod: customer-impact: two mid-market customers in eu reported increased errors; CS alerted. Erin, can you ping them and set expectation?

erin_custsuccess: will message now — short note to affected customers and offer to failover to hosted endpoint if they want it immediately. Also flag for SLA review.

sasha_sre: after scale up started, still seeing some blackholed connections inside proxy where the connection manager kept older circuit mapping to quant-v2. I'm going to restart proxy workers for the pool one at a time to flush stale routing table.

amanda_eng: restarting worker shards on pool proxy 1/3 -> 17:53:22
amanda_eng: 2/3 -> 17:53:57
amanda_eng: 3/3 -> 17:54:20

ops-bot: infra events: new nodes joined dedicated-eu-gen2 at 17:54:50, pool reported slots restored to 120 at 17:55:08

tom_router: router telemetry shows 5xx dropping back to baseline within 90s after worker restarts and policy pause. Verified new requests are routed to stable variants.

maria_oncall: good. Can we confirm root cause: autoscaler misread because heartbeat tag renamed in agent deploy -> autoscaler considered pool unhealthy -> scale-down path -> router fallback policy preferred quant-v2 which was unhealthy for other reasons (maybe quant handshake bug) -> blackhole when proxy mapping stale. Chain: deploy -> tag rename -> scale-down -> variant selection -> proxy mapping stale -> customer impact. Agree?
\eein: (typo)

sasha_sre: yes that's the chain. Two contributing bugs: uncoordinated tag rename in agent and an unsafe default in fallback policy that prioritizes quant variants aggressively when capacity low.

amanda_eng: action items I'm taking: revert agent tag change in canary and audit deploy checklist to include heartbeat tag mapping. Will open a PR for a safer fallback priority (lower quant variant weight by default).

lee_infra: infra action: add rename-detection to autoscaler metric ingestion and a 3-minute grace for heartbeat tag absence during deploy windows. Also add explicit deploy flag to temporarily suppress scale decisions.

jordan_prod: CS action: send full incident note to affected customers with ETA and remediation steps. Erin will handle outreach.

erin_custsuccess: message sent to customers at 17:56:40: "We detected increased errors and have applied mitigations. We're offering immediate failover to hosted routing and will follow up with a root-cause report."

maria_oncall: rolling into handoff: I'll leave this at monitoring stage. Metrics stable for 5m, 5xx ~0.3%. Leaving postmortem TODOs: incident write-up, deploy checklist update, fallback policy safety throttles, autoscaler tag resilience. Assign owners: amanda_eng (deploy checklist + fallback weight PR), lee_infra (autoscaler ingestion change), sasha_sre (proxy routing hardening + canary tests), tom_router (policy config defaults).

maria_oncall: handing to morning oncall @amanda_eng for follow-ups — please escalate to oncall rotation if regresses. Handoff notes in ops-runbook link: https://wiki.internal/ops/runbooks/fallback-incident-1777777777

ops-bot: incident closed -> page resolved at 17:59:26 by maria_oncall (status: mitigated, severity: P2).

amanda_eng: acknowledging handoff. Starting draft postmortem now. Will include timeline and customer impact numbers.

jordan_prod: thanks team. quick recap to include customer counts and minutes of downtime per tenant for SLA reconciliation.

sasha_sre: leaving monitoring alerts with higher threshold and alert to deployment channel when heartbeat tag changes detected.

maria_oncall: great work. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
